# Codependent Coding doctrine (condensed)

Classify before creating a file. Lint findings print a CC-* ID: fix the cause, never disable the rule. Never report a check as passing unless you ran it.

## Classifier

Answer top to bottom; the first yes is the file's home. `<d>` is the domain (module id).

```text
Static public presentation?      app/(public) page + components/blocks
React Hook Form?                 features/<d>/<d><Verb><Thing>Form.tsx
Browser-only behavior?           features/<d>/<name>.client.tsx
Capability orchestration?        features/<d>/<d><Thing>Feature.tsx
Persisted read?                  lib/fetchers/<d>Fetchers.ts
Ordinary CRUD write?             lib/actions/<d>Actions.ts
Named application logic?         lib/workflows/<d>Workflows.ts
Multi-write atomicity?           lib/db/transactions/<d>-<verb>-<noun>.tx.ts
Prisma select / DTO?             lib/db/selects | lib/db/dto
Identity?                        lib/auth
Access decision?                 lib/authz
Provider SDK?                    lib/integrations/<provider>
Webhook HTTP lifecycle?          app/api/<provider>/webhooks/route.ts
Runtime validation?              schemas/<d>Schemas.ts
Shared type?                     types/<d>Types.ts
Cache tag / lifetime?            lib/cache
Constant / pure util?            lib/constants | lib/utils
None of the above?               Stop. Do not invent a layer (CC-NAME-002).
```

## Rules

| ID            | Layer            | Rule                                                                                                              | Enforced by                                 |
| ------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| CC-ROUTE-001  | route            | Routes never import DB, fetchers, actions, workflows, integrations, provider SDKs, Clerk server, or UI primitives | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-ROUTE-002  | proxy            | proxy.ts only gates routes                                                                                        | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-HOOK-001   | route-handler    | Route handlers: no Prisma runtime, provider SDKs, Clerk server, or presentation                                   | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-FEAT-001   | feature          | Normal features: no DB, transactions, integrations, SDKs, UI primitives, React Hook Form                          | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-FEAT-002   | feature-form     | Forms: no DB, fetchers, workflows, integrations; initial values arrive as props                                   | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-FEAT-003   | feature-skeleton | Skeletons import only components/ui/skeleton and blocks                                                           | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-FEAT-004   | feature-client   | Client companions: interactive UI controls + actions; no server reads or authz                                    | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-BLOCK-001  | block            | Blocks and templates are pure presentation                                                                        | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-BLOCK-002  | nav              | Nav and shells are pure presentation; Clerk UI widgets allowed                                                    | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-UI-001     | ui               | UI primitives import only primitives, utils, hooks, types                                                         | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-UI-002     | hook             | Hooks are browser-side                                                                                            | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-READ-001   | fetcher          | Fetchers: no actions, workflows, integrations, transactions                                                       | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-READ-002   | fetcher          | Fetchers never call Prisma write methods                                                                          | `eslint:codependent/no-fetcher-writes`      |
| CC-WRITE-001  | action           | Actions: no integrations or provider SDKs                                                                         | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-WRITE-002  | action           | Action modules start with 'use server'                                                                            | `eslint:codependent/use-server-actions`     |
| CC-WRITE-003  | action           | Actions authenticate, authorize, and Zod-validate before writing; return ActionResult                             | `review`                                    |
| CC-FLOW-001   | workflow         | Workflows: no Prisma client, provider SDKs, or presentation                                                       | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-TX-001     | transaction      | Transactions perform database work only                                                                           | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-TX-002     | transaction      | No fetch() inside transactions                                                                                    | `eslint:codependent/no-transaction-network` |
| CC-DB-001     | db               | lib/db never imports app layers                                                                                   | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-DB-002     | any              | No $queryRawUnsafe/$executeRawUnsafe; tagged raw SQL only in lib/db                                               | `eslint:codependent/no-raw-sql`             |
| CC-AUTH-001   | auth             | Authentication never decides access                                                                               | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-AUTHZ-001  | authz            | Authorization never reads Clerk server state                                                                      | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-INT-001    | integration      | Integrations never persist                                                                                        | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-CACHE-001  | cache            | Cache helpers hold semantics only                                                                                 | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-PURE-001   | pure             | Constants, utils, types are dependency-free                                                                       | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-SCHEMA-001 | schema           | Zod schemas are pure (Prisma enums allowed)                                                                       | `eslint:codependent/layer-boundaries`       |
| CC-SRV-001    | server           | Server modules import 'server-only'                                                                               | `eslint:codependent/require-server-only`    |
| CC-CLIENT-001 | any              | 'use client' only in .client.tsx, Form features, components, hooks, error boundaries                              | `eslint:codependent/use-client-placement`   |
| CC-NAME-001   | any              | Directory naming conventions                                                                                      | `eslint:codependent/filename-convention`    |
| CC-NAME-002   | any              | No services/managers/processors/helpers/misc/common/handlers layers                                               | `eslint:codependent/no-generic-names`       |
| CC-STYLE-001  | any              | Named exports only (framework special files and config excepted)                                                  | `eslint:codependent/no-default-export`      |
| CC-STYLE-002  | any              | Import through @/; no parent-relative imports                                                                     | `eslint:codependent/no-parent-imports`      |
| CC-MOD-001    | module           | Cross-module imports only via declared dependsOn                                                                  | `eslint:codependent/module-boundaries`      |
| CC-MOD-002    | base             | Base never imports module-owned files (registry excepted)                                                         | `eslint:codependent/module-boundaries`      |
| CC-MOD-003    | any              | Every file has exactly one owner                                                                                  | `script:pnpm check:ownership`               |
| CC-FMT-001    | any              | Prettier owns formatting                                                                                          | `prettier`                                  |
| CC-FMT-002    | any              | Tailwind classes sorted                                                                                           | `prettier:prettier-plugin-tailwindcss`      |
| CC-TS-001     | any              | strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes                                                      | `tsconfig`                                  |
| CC-TS-002     | any              | No explicit any; no non-null assertions outside vendored UI and tests                                             | `eslint:@typescript-eslint`                 |
| CC-SEC-001    | any              | Tenant scope in every tenant query predicate                                                                      | `review`                                    |
| CC-SEC-002    | any              | Every tenant table has forced RLS and is covered by test:rls                                                      | `script:pnpm test:rls`                      |
| CC-SEC-003    | route-handler    | Webhooks verify raw body and are idempotent                                                                       | `review`                                    |
| CC-SEC-004    | any              | No consequential decision from cache                                                                              | `review`                                    |
| CC-SEC-005    | any              | Cross-tenant access returns NOT_FOUND                                                                             | `script:pnpm test:rls`                      |
| CC-SEC-006    | any              | No secrets in NEXT_PUBLIC_*; env validated in lib/env                                                             | `review`                                    |
| CC-UX-001     | route            | Dynamic tenant pages wrap features in Suspense with a feature skeleton                                            | `review`                                    |
